note: Every feature below was hand-inspected in the real GoOnlinePOS source before being added here, and is re-verified against that same source every time this script runs. 'verified': false means an expected anchor no longer matches - the claim needs re-checking before it's used in marketing content.

features.description: Optional per-product stock tracking. Stock decrements automatically on every sale and can be corrected/restocked from Settings -> Inventory.
features.benefit: Know what's actually left on the shelf without a separate spreadsheet, and never oversell an item you're out of.
marketing_angles: Track your stock without relying on manual spreadsheets.
Stock updates itself the moment you make a sale.
features.problem: Still counting stock by hand or guessing what's left on the shelf?
features.target_audience: Shop owners who track their own inventory - convenience stores, small retail, home-based sellers.
features.premium_note: Viewing and tracking stock is free; editing stock numbers or exporting the inventory list requires Premium (see app.html's applyPremiumLocks()).

features.description: Each product can carry a photo, auto-compressed client-side to a small 160px JPEG so the whole catalog still fits comfortably in browser storage.
features.page_or_location: app.html - Settings -> Products / the main catalog grid
features.benefit: Cashiers find items faster by sight, especially useful for food, bakery, or lookalike products.
marketing_angles: Add a real photo to every product - find items by sight, not just by name.
features.problem: Cashiers wasting time squinting at a text-only product list to find the right item.
features.target_audience: Cashiers and shop staff working a busy counter, especially with lookalike products like food or bakery items.
features.premium_note: Included in the free Basic plan.

features.description: The whole product catalog can be replaced in one step by uploading a CSV or .xlsx/.xls file (Name/Price/Category/SKU, optional Stock/TaxExempt).
features.benefit: Load hundreds of products in minutes from a spreadsheet you already have, instead of typing each one in by hand.
marketing_angles: Already have your product list in Excel? Upload it and you're ready to sell.
features.problem: Typing in a hundred products one at a time before you can even open for business.
features.target_audience: New shop owners setting up their catalog for the first time, or anyone migrating from a spreadsheet.
features.premium_note: Included in the free Basic plan.

features.description: Keyboard-wedge style USB barcode scanner support - a fast keystroke burst ending in Enter is matched against product SKU and added to the cart automatically.
features.page_or_location: app.html - main catalog screen, Barcode Scanner toggle
features.benefit: Ring up items as fast as a real checkout counter - plug in any standard USB barcode scanner, no special drivers.
marketing_angles: Plug in a $20 USB barcode scanner and start scanning - no setup, no drivers.
features.problem: Ringing up items by typing the name in manually, one by one, while a line builds up.
features.target_audience: Retail cashiers and convenience-store staff who already own a standard USB barcode scanner.
features.premium_note: Included in the free Basic plan.

features.description: A single sale can be paid using more than one payment method (e.g. part cash, part card) by adding extra payment rows at checkout.
features.benefit: Handle real-world customers who want to pay part cash, part card, without any workaround.
marketing_angles: Customer paying half cash, half card? One sale, one receipt, no problem.
features.problem: A customer wants to pay part cash, part card, and the register can't handle it in one sale.
features.target_audience: Cashiers handling walk-in retail or food-service customers with mixed payment habits.
features.premium_note: Included in the free Basic plan.

features.description: A percent or fixed-amount discount can be applied at checkout, and any item (catalog default or overridden per sale) can be marked tax-exempt.
features.benefit: Apply a one-off discount to a single customer, or exempt specific items from tax, without changing your store-wide settings.
marketing_angles: Give one customer a discount without touching your store-wide pricing.
features.problem: Needing to give one customer a one-off discount without touching your store-wide prices.
features.target_audience: Shop owners who occasionally negotiate price or serve tax-exempt customers or organizations.
features.premium_note: Included in the free Basic plan.

features.description: Multiple named cashiers can be configured; each sale records which cashier rang it up, and End of Day / Sales History report totals broken down per cashier.
features.page_or_location: app.html - Settings -> Cashiers, End of Day report
features.benefit: See exactly how much each staff member sold and collected during a shift.
marketing_angles: Know exactly which cashier rang up which sale - no guessing at shift-close.
features.problem: No way to tell which staff member rang up which sale when the register comes up short.
features.target_audience: Shop owners with more than one person working the register across shifts.
features.premium_note: Included in the free Basic plan.

features.feature: Sales History + Printable End of Day Report
features.description: Every completed sale is saved and browsable/editable in Sales History. A separate End of Day report (end-of-day.html) totals a chosen day's sales, items sold, payment-method breakdown, and per-cashier collection, and can be printed or saved as a frozen snapshot.
features.page_or_location: app.html header -> End of Day, end-of-day.html
features.benefit: Close out the register with a real report - total sales, best sellers, and cash-vs-card breakdown - not a mental tally.
marketing_angles: Close your register with a real report, not a guess - totals, best sellers, and payment breakdown in one click.
features.problem: Closing the register with a mental guess instead of a real total.
features.target_audience: Shop owners and managers closing out a business day.
features.premium_note: Included in the free Basic plan.

features.description: Sales History (optionally filtered by date range) and Inventory can both be exported to a real .xlsx workbook, or CSV as a fallback.
features.benefit: Hand your accountant a real spreadsheet of sales for any date range, no manual re-typing.
marketing_angles: Download your sales as a real Excel file for any date range - ready for your accountant.
features.problem: Hand-copying sales numbers into a spreadsheet every time your accountant asks for them.
features.target_audience: Shop owners who work with an accountant or bookkeeper, or file their own taxes.
features.premium_note: Sales export is not Premium-gated (only Inventory export is - see applyPremiumLocks()).

features.description: A second, lightweight page (customer.html) mirrors the live cart/order state in real time, meant for a second monitor or a screen facing the customer. This is a Premium feature - app.html's applyPremiumLocks() keeps it locked until Premium is active.
features.benefit: Let the customer see exactly what's being rung up and the running total, the way a supermarket checkout does.
marketing_angles: Give your customer their own screen showing exactly what they're being charged.
features.problem: A customer at the counter has no way to see what they're actually being charged until the receipt prints.
features.target_audience: Retail and food-service shop owners who want a supermarket-style checkout experience - Premium subscribers.
features.premium_note: Fully Premium-gated - app.html's applyPremiumLocks() hides the unlocked customer-screen content entirely until Premium is active.

features.description: One-click download of every piece of local data (products, sales, settings, cashiers, logo) as a JSON file, and a matching restore that loads it back in.
features.benefit: Move to a new computer or recover from a cleared browser without losing your product list or sales history.
marketing_angles: Your data lives in your browser - back it up with one click so you never lose it.
features.problem: A cleared browser or a new computer wiping out your entire product list and sales history.
features.target_audience: Any shop owner relying on a browser-based POS for day-to-day data.
features.premium_note: Included in the free Basic plan.

features.description: Store currency code/symbol is configurable, affecting every price, receipt, and total shown throughout the app.
features.benefit: Runs correctly for a business pricing in dollars, dinars, pesos, or any other currency, not just USD.
marketing_angles: Set your own currency once - every receipt, price, and report follows.
features.problem: A POS that only prices in US dollars, when your business runs in a different currency entirely.
features.target_audience: Shop owners outside the US, or anyone pricing in a currency other than USD.
features.premium_note: Included in the free Basic plan.

features.description: The entire app UI (and the marketing site, and the free tools) can be switched between English, Arabic (with full RTL layout), Filipino, Hindi, Spanish, and Thai.
features.benefit: Staff and customers can use the POS in the language they're actually comfortable with, including full right-to-left Arabic.
marketing_angles: Switch the entire POS between English, Arabic, Filipino, Hindi, Spanish, and Thai.
features.problem: Staff or customers who aren't comfortable reading the POS in English.
features.target_audience: Multilingual staff and customer-facing businesses, including Arabic-speaking markets needing full right-to-left layout.
features.premium_note: Included in the free Basic plan.

features.description: Printed receipts can target 58mm/80mm thermal paper, A4, A5, or a custom width, with the on-screen preview and the real printed output kept in sync.
features.benefit: Print on whatever printer you already own - a thermal receipt printer or a normal A4/Letter printer - no extra hardware required.
marketing_angles: No thermal printer? Print receipts on any regular A4 printer instead.
features.problem: Feeling like you need to buy a special thermal printer just to use a POS.
features.target_audience: Shop owners using a regular A4/Letter printer instead of a dedicated thermal receipt printer.
features.premium_note: Included in the free Basic plan.

features.description: A Premium feature that builds a self-contained, zero-network .zip of the entire app, live in the browser, that runs with a local Python server or directly via file:// with no internet connection required.
features.page_or_location: app.html - Settings -> Backup -> Download Offline POS (Premium)
features.benefit: Keep selling even with no internet connection at all - a real concern for market stalls, pop-ups, and spotty-wifi locations.
marketing_angles: No internet at your market stall? Download the offline version and keep selling.
features.problem: Losing the ability to sell the moment the wifi drops.
features.target_audience: Market stall vendors, pop-up shops, and any location with unreliable internet - Premium subscribers.
features.premium_note: Requires an active Premium subscription to download.

features.description: A free-standing invoice builder (invoice-generator.html) for formal, net-terms billing to a customer - separate from POS checkout receipts.
features.benefit: Send a proper, professional invoice to a customer on net terms - not every sale is a same-day cash sale.
marketing_angles: Need to bill a customer on terms, not just ring up a cash sale? Create a real invoice free.
features.problem: Needing to bill a customer on net terms instead of a same-day cash sale, without dedicated invoicing software.
features.target_audience: Freelancers, small service businesses, and shop owners who occasionally invoice rather than ring up a sale.
features.premium_note: A separate free tool with no Premium concept at all.

features.feature: Free Barcode & QR Code Generator (standalone tool)
features.description: A free-standing generator (barcode-generator.html) for common barcode symbologies (CODE128, EAN-13, UPC-A, and more) and QR codes, with print-ready label sizing and PNG export.
features.benefit: Generate real, scannable barcodes for products that don't already have one, ready to print on labels.
marketing_angles: New product with no barcode yet? Generate a scannable one free, sized for your label printer.
features.problem: A new product with no barcode yet, and no easy way to generate one.
features.target_audience: Shop owners adding new products that don't already have a manufacturer barcode.
features.premium_note: A separate free tool with no Premium concept at all.

features.feature: Premium Subscription (sign in once, use anywhere)
features.description: Signing in with Google grants a free 15-day Premium trial automatically; Premium unlocks logo upload, receipt numbering, inventory export, the customer screen, and the offline download, and follows the signed-in account to any device rather than being tied to one browser.
features.benefit: Unlock extra features on a free trial with just a Google sign-in, no card required, and it follows you to any device you sign into.
marketing_angles: Get 15 days of Premium free - just sign in with Google, no card needed.
features.problem: Wanting to try extra features without committing to a paid plan first.
features.target_audience: Any GoOnlinePOS user curious about Premium features.
features.premium_note: This entry describes the Premium system itself, not a Premium-gated feature.
